scripts.build:template: cargo pvm-contract build --manifest-path src/templates/shared-counter/Cargo.toml -p counter && cargo pvm-contract build --manifest-path src/templates/shared-counter/Cargo.toml -p counter_reader && cargo pvm-contract build --manifest-path src/templates/shared-counter/Cargo.toml -p counter_writer && cargo pvm-contract build --manifest-path src/templates/instagram/Cargo.toml -p instagram
scripts.check: pnpm embed:templates && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm test:macro && pnpm test:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo test -p cdm-macros -p pvm-cdm -p pvm-cdm-macros -p contract-registry-core -p contract-registry -p contract-registry-proxy -p create3-factory -p create3-child --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')"
scripts.format: biome format --write . && cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --manifest-path src/templates/shared-counter/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: biome format . && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo fmt --all --manifest-path src/templates/shared-counter/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.compile:cli: pnpm build:ts && pnpm embed:templates && bun build --compile src/apps/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cdm
scripts.compile:all: pnpm build:ts && pnpm embed:templates && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/apps/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cdm-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/apps/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cdm-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/apps/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cdm-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 src/apps/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cdm-linux-arm64
scripts.deploy:registry: pnpm build:registry && turbo build --filter=@parity/cdm-env --filter=@parity/cdm-builder && bun run src/lib/scripts/deploy-registry.ts
